section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch46 — Ancient & Medieval India
subject: Social Studies
stem: Gautama Buddha attained enlightenment under a Bodhi tree at which present-day location?
explanation: Buddha attained enlightenment at Bodh Gaya. He was born at Lumbini, gave his first sermon at Sarnath, and attained Mahaparinirvana at Kushinagar.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch46 — Ancient & Medieval India
subject: Social Studies
stem: The Mughal Emperor who built the Taj Mahal in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal was:
explanation: Shah Jahan commissioned the Taj Mahal as a mausoleum for Mumtaz Mahal. Akbar built Fatehpur Sikri.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch48 — Indian & World Geography
subject: Social Studies
stem: Tropical evergreen forests, found in regions with over 200 cm of annual rainfall, are characterised by:

options.option_text: Dense, multi-layered canopy of trees that do not shed leaves together in any season
Short thorny scrub adapted to very low rainfall
Trees that shed all their leaves together in a fixed season
Absence of any tree cover, only grassland

explanation: Tropical evergreen forests get abundant rainfall and remain green year-round with a dense multi-layer canopy — unlike deciduous forests (seasonal shedding) or thorny scrub (arid regions).

subject: Social Studies
stem: At the village level, the elected body of local self-government under the Panchayati Raj system is called the:
explanation: The three tiers are Gram Panchayat (village), Panchayat Samiti (block), and Zilla Parishad (district).
